notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.11
notes.content: Bug fixes for the boss loot system.

notes.title: ECONOMY REFORGED
notes.content:
Based on player feedbacks, we have made adjustments to the economy and equipment system to enhance balance and gameplay experience.
CHANGES

Bosses at the end of levels now gives Soul Shards upon defeat. 
(Golem:15 | Demon:20 | Frozen Golem:25 | Beholder:30 | Drond:20 | Drund:20)
Adjusted the conversion cost for Soul Shards. (10000 ▶ 6666)
Adjusted the amount of Soul Shards obtained from certain altars. (2nd Wave Basic(3 ▶ 5) | 2nd Wave Obelisk(5 ▶ 7) | 2nd Wave Blacksmith(7 ▶ 9))
All equipments are now unlockable in the game.

Bosses now drop a chest upon defeat, which unlocks 3 to 6 equipments, depending on luck.
Once unlocked, these equipments can be purchased from the Blacksmith.
Made changes to the Bestiary screen to display the drop rates of equipments for each boss.
Equipments previously purchased will be immediately usable after unlocking and do not need to be repurchased.
If you unequip currently equipped armors, you will need to unlock them again before re-equipping.
Reduced the price of all armors to one-third of their original cost.
Adjusted the prices of some rings.

Revive Ring [14 ▶ 5]
Ring of Dwarf Warrior [24 ▶ 10]
Ring of Giant Warrior [32 ▶ 15]
Ring of Double Punishment [34 ▶ 16]
Fateweaver's Ring [36 ▶ 17]

Last Judgement [52 ▶ 25]
Ring of Scarred Soul [82 ▶ 37]
Adjusted the prices of some empowerments.

Enemies now scale more in Endless Mode.
Added an icon next to the difficulty icon in the level selection UI to indicate increased gold rewards.
Added different colors for emphasis to certain words in equipment descriptions.
Made improvements to armor set descriptions and their tier-based attributes for better clarity.

FIXES

Fixed an issue on the Dor'galor's Trials where the game would not progress.
Fixed visual issues on the loading screen occurring at certain resolutions and aspect ratios.
Fixed the collider for the anvil at the Blacksmith Altar.
Fixed an issue where the Comet ability would sometimes target incorrectly on the Winterland and Sewer maps.
Fixed an issue where stacking experience crystals resulted in incorrect amounts being granted.

notes.content:

[CHANGE] Updated the ability visuals for Flying Twins.

Chests now provide loot based on their type.
When the limit(500) of experience crystals on the ground is reached, the farthest crystals will now stack together.

The description for the Ring of Scarred Soul has been corrected.
Issues related to the health because of the Ring of Scarred Soul have been fixed.

Reroll Count 250 ➡ 175
Banish 5000 ➡ 4000
Banish Count 250 ➡ 200

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.15 and LINUX SUPPORT [BETA]
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the level-up UI and inventory UI overlapped.
Updated the main menu.
Fixed an issue where inventory slots were not visible.
Improved the magnet functionality: experience crystals now stack together when pulled in.
Added a dialogue to the blacksmith to provide information about the Spellforge.
Updated Arcane Storm: it is now affected by the skill speed.
Added skill levels display to the HUD.
Introduced the "Q" key to view passive abilities and their levels in-game.
Added support for the game to function on all resolutions while maintaining the original screen size and resolution. Blackbars now appear on the sides, top, or bottom depending on the resolution.
Souls now move with increasing speed.
Experience crystals now move with increasing speed.
Fixed a bug in the portal located in the Cemetery.
Added Linux support. Currently in beta and under testing.

We’re thrilled to announce the release of Heroes & Redemption 1.0! After months of changes and refining, shaped by your invaluable feedback, the game is finally ready.

6 New enemies (Assassin, Drond's Goblin, Deadly Skeleton, Deadly Skeleton with Shield, Skeleton Mage with Shield, Skeleton Mage with Rusty Shield)
2 New bosses (Drond and Drund)

Limited time, stronger enemies but more rewarding... Can you survive in these familiar places?

 UI

 UI palette, colors and details are overhauled.
 More detailed and renewed result screen.
 Easy to use and detailed inventory screen.
 Detailed information about items and armors with their current stats and more in inventory.
 Detailed character stats.

 More information about starting weapon for characters in character selection and character purchase screen.

 Achievements
29 new achievements.
[spoiler]Ring Bearer, Sacred Rune, Mythic Runes, Empowered!, Blade Whisperer, Woodland Scout, Voidcaller, Tome of Regret, Book of Requiem, Poisonous Mist, Aqua: Stream, Novice Challenger, Skilled Adventurer, Trial Master, Arena Conqueror, Legend of the Trials, Filthy Survivor, Sludge Slayer, Mire Warrior, Sewer Sentinel, Depth Dominator, Escaped Prisoner, Jailbreaker, Dungeon Warden, Chains of Fate, Liberator of the Forgotten, Elven Lute, Soul Infuser, Magic Anvil.[/spoiler]
 Other

 Endless Mode.
 Some of skill visuals has been changed.
 After level 60, the experience required to level up has been reduced.
 After maxing out all skills, you receive gold with each level up.
 Character stats and prices has been changed.
 Armor prices has been changed.
 Armor stat has been added to bosses.
 You can purchase 10 soul shards with one click.
 Performance optimizations.
[/olist]
🙏 Thank You!

We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to all of you. Your support, suggestions, and participation in testing have been invaluable in making this milestone possible.

🚀 What’s Next?

Version 1.0 is just the beginning! Future updates will continue to focus on your feedback, along with exciting new updates.

If you haven’t played the game yet, now is the perfect time to start!

Thank you for joining us on this journey. We can’t wait to hear your thoughts, see your feedback, and share more ideas together.

It’s time to embark on your adventure!

notes.title: UPCOMING UPDATES AND NEWS
notes.content:
Hello heroes, we are here with big news today.
We are pleased to announce the changes and news regarding the upcoming release of Heroes & Redemption 1.0
You can view some of the updates and changes below.
There may be changes and additions in this list in the future.
[olist]
 New Items

 Poisonous Mist
As the character moves, it creates acid clouds behind that deal damage to enemies.
 Aqua: Stream
Sprays water in four directions around the character.
 Tome of Regret
A curse has been added to the game. When you acquire this curse, enemies' health, speed and damage increase. Additionally, more enemies spawn.

 Empowerment System
Empowered versions of each spell have been added to the game. For example, Relentless Strike has three empowerments: Storm Slash, Hellfire Strike and Supreme Strike. Each empowerment adds different attributes to the skill, allowing you to choose the one that best fits your playstyle.

 List of all empowerment skills:
 Sacred Aura

 Divine Vampirism: Deals damage to nearby enemies and drains their health.
 Divine Deceleration: Deals damage to nearby enemies and slows them down as well.
 Ethereal Might: Deals much more damage to nearby enemies.

 Sacred Ring

 Burning Radiance: Orbs deal additional fire damage to enemies they touch.
 Soul Reaver: Orbs drain health from enemies they touch.
 Ring of Aquanis: Orbs slow down enemies they touch.

 Flying Twins 

 Arc Spread: Fires three spells in a conical spread in the direction the character is facing. The number of spells created increases with the skill amount.
 Dispersing Twins: Creates a number of spells equal to the skill amount and spreads them outwards from the character.

 Flying Seal

 Tempest Seal: Now it's much, much faster.

 Arcane Storm

 Arcane Maelstrom: The number of rotating circles now increases with skill amount.

 Titan's Lightning

 Primordial Thunderfall: Creates an explosion where it strikes.

 Devastation Ritual 

 Apocalyptic Ritual: It reduces its size but spawns under enemies depending on the skill amount.

 Demonic Flux

 Eldritch Demonic Flux: Removes the damage reduction with each bounce.

 Comet

 Polyburst: Shoots 3 projectiles per shot instead of 1
 Impactful Comet: Explodes at the location where it bounces, dealing area damage.

 Relentless Strike

 Storm Slash: Marks the enemies it hits, and they will explode when they take another hit.
 Hellfire Strike: Deals additional fire damage.
 Supreme Strike: Swings much more powerfully.

 Conjurrang

 Magnetized Conjurrang: It is now more powerful and brings experience crystals to the player.

 Binding Roots

 Blooming Root: Blooms a plant beneath the marked enemy that shoots at other enemies.
 Wild Grasp: Instead of slowing down, it now roots all enemies in its area.

 Sacred Ritual

 Nova Vortex: It explodes twice.

 Chain Lightning 

 Shocking Surge: Stuns each enemy it hits.
 Chain Havoc: Deals area damage with each hit.

 Lightning of Sodnir

 Thunderfield: The number of thunder bolts now increases with skill amount.

 Aqua: Blast

 Aqua: Riptide: Water now explodes in a larger area and deals more damage

 Poisonous Mist

 Noxious Veil: It's always active.

 Aqua: Stream

 Tidal Force: It now sprays water in 8 directions.


 New Playable Characters

 Rogue - Mokdarr

 New Maps

 Sewer (4th Map)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44547664/0528a3b0f20ec1778483a86348e731e658ede0ff.png
Can you make it through this rat-infested sewer without fainting from the stench?

 Old Prison (5th Map)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44547664/a8eb2eb5ab36f44e4027cc3963de42ae6287ba04.png
What can you do in this prison full of traps where old prisoners have spent years?

 Catacomb (Bonus Map)
Limited time, stronger enemies but more rewarding... Can you survive in these familiar places?

 Some Changes

 Performance optimization.
 Binding Roots appearance has changed.
 Titan's Lightning appearance has changed.
 The spell "Water: Blast" has been renamed "Aqua: Blast".
 No more buying soul shards one by one in our Blacksmith brother, with the 10x button you can buy 10 soul shards with one click! (If you have enough gold of course...)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.71.2439
notes.content:
CHANGES

 Bestiary unlocked. The basic stat information of the enemies you have previously killed can now be viewed here. (Enemies that have been previously killed but do not currently have save data may appear locked)
 The Flying Seal ability no longer fires from a fixed position.
 The Banish system has been changed. 

 The right to choose items is not lost when Banish is used.
 When banished, the banished slot and the item in that slot are deleted.
 If 3 slots are banished and there is no reroll or skip, the right to choose items is lost. 
 If reroll is used, 3 new slots are recreated.

 Some changes have been made to the cave map.

 Small stone spikes that caused a lot of blocks and were very difficult to see in the midst of chaos have been deleted or moved to more ideal locations.
 Large stone spikes were moved away from each other in some positions if they were too close.
 An additional connection path has been added to the corridor northwest of the map's spawn point.
 Added a passage to the dead end northeast of the map's spawn point.

 Altar quests are now also affected by the difficulty multiplier.

 Obelisk Altar health increases with difficulty multiplier.
 Blacksmith Altar health and health regeneration increases with difficulty multiplier.
 NPC Protection Altar health increases with difficulty multiplier.

 Added Tier 2 Rune of Knowledge. (Experience Gain)
 Added Tier 2 Rune of Fortune. (Luck)
 Rune of Fortune increased from 3 levels to 4 levels. Price reduced from 7000 to 5250.
 Book of Fortune reduced from 5 levels to 4 levels.
 Luck stat now increases directly by multiplying by the item weight instead of adding to it. (For owned items only)

 Reduced the cooldown reduction provided by Robe of Crul'xad from 5 to 4.
 Reduced the cooldown reduction provided by Gauntlets of Crul'xad from 2 to 1.
 Reduced the cooldown reduction provided by Leggings of Crul'xad from 3 to 2.
 The base stats provided by runes are now displayed when purchasing.
 Rune of Might's damage and cost have been increased.
 Fixed issues with some base stats not updating.
 Fixed the issue of leveling up at the exact moment of death.
 Fixed some issues with Altars.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.712433
notes.content:
CHANGES

 Like reroll, banish also requires purchasing quantity.(Max: 5)
 Once the Demon is killed on the Cemetery map, the maze sequence can be skipped.
 Fixed the issue of Book of Fortune not unlocking.
 Snowfall no longer pauses when the game is paused on the Winterland map.
 An indicator now appears after completing the Altar quest.

notes.title: WINTERLAND UPDATE
notes.content:
NEW CONTENT

 Winterland map added.
 2 new unlockables. (Sacred Ritual, Book of Fortune)
 6 new enemies. (Masked, Elite Masked, Ghost, Mutant Eye, Death Mage and Elite Death Mage)
 New boss. (Frozen Golem)
 Added 2 new achievements related to Winterland.

Winterland map added as beta. There is a high probability of bugs, especially in Altars. I don't know for sure since it spawns in a random position and with a random quest every time. If you encounter a bug, please report back. Winterland enemies are difficult in general, and possibly higher level difficulties may be impossible right now. It could possibly provide a more balanced experience when new tiers arrive for meta-progression on difficult levels.

CHANGES

 Cooldown and duration values ​​have been adjusted for each level of Berserker's Rage.
 The full set damage and radius of the Fiery Cape bonus from the Crul'xad armor set has been reduced. (DMG: 3 ➡️ 2, RAD: 3.5 ➡️ 3)
 After teleporting to the boss arena, the spawn time of the boss has been changed to 1 second.
 Chain Lightning ability's cooldown times have been reduced and its damage has been increased.
 Increased Conjurrang's first level damage. (5 ➡️ 10)
 Corinna Blakemore (Paladin) movement speed increased.
 Corinna Blakemore (Paladin) starting ability changed from Sacred Aura to Conjurrang.
 Movement speed debuffs on the Dor'galor armor set have been reduced.
 Movement speed debuffs on the Ixdarr armor set have been reduced.
 The menu named achievements in the pause menu has been changed to unlockables.


FIXES

 Fixed the bug that prevented Lexicon of Greedy from unlocking.
 Fixed the issue where Cemetery Boss (Demon) would spawn with less health than normal.
 Fixed disappearing chests.
 Fixed the issue where armor sets would not give buffs when wearing 4 pieces.
 Fixed the issue where animations were not played correctly when moving slowly while playing with a gamepad.
 Fixed the issue where damage indicators would appear in the wrong color when you block incoming damage with evade.
 Fixed the issue where Berserker's Rage was not visible in the hood.


UPCOMING

I think there will be new meta progress tiers, but before that, balancing will be done for a while to improve the experience, please do not forget to send feedback.

⚔️

notes.title: UPDATE 0.70.24292
notes.content:
CHANGES

Removed the white icon that appears if there are less than 3 items left to collect when leveling up.
Warrior's Sacred Aura skill visual changed.
Fire Bat have been balanced. (They now have less health but deal more damage)
Fixed the issue with equipping armor in the blacksmith interface.
Fixed the bug that caused the Winterland map to be unlocked. (Winterland map will be added in the next update)
The character selection interface has been made easier to understand.
Item prices in the Vendor interface are only displayed if they are purchasable.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.7024282
notes.content:
CHANGES

Fixed incorrect unlock description for Ruby. (Unlocks after completing the second altar)
Fixed incorrect unlock description for Vougrim the Unliving. (Can be found in the Cemetery)
The amount of gold dropped from chests has been increased. (10, 25, 50, 75, 150 ➡️ 100, 250, 500, 750, 1500)
Chests now give random experience points within a certain range instead of fixed. (100 ➡️ 50-250)
Prices of all characters available for purchase after unlocking have been reduced. (Mage 4000, Necromancer 5000, Paladin 6000)
The tabs in the Vendor and Blacksmith interface now have icons appropriate to the tab content.
Fixed a bug that caused the gold chest to close after interacting with it.

notes.title: Update 0.61.231011
notes.content:
Hey Heroes!
Based on player feedbacks we've made a little update.


(Fix) Dialogues that makes player stuck is now fixed.
(New) There is more interactable dialogues in hub.
(Update) Chests now gives Gold, Experience and Soul Shards directly to player.
(Update) Health Potions are no longer used automatically. You can use them by interacting with them.
(New) Chests now have a item drop indicators.
(New) Added death and hit SFX for player.
(New) Added screen shake and screen damage. (You can toggle screen shake in options)
(Fix) Bug that makes Relentless Strike instantly kills boss is now fixed.
(Fix) Game over screen is no longer gets stuck on screen.
